content: You, 'The Bandit.' Living up to that name, you're thirsty to snatch anything you can from the hands of others, and not just money, either.

raw: [name="Outcast"]You steal their dignity, and your lust for it will bring whole countries to ruin.
speaker: Outcast
content: You steal their dignity, and your lust for it will bring whole countries to ruin.

raw: [name="Outcast"]And then there's you, 'The Elocutionist.' You're really into those five dollar words, trying your hardest to turn fancy talk into a political weapon, the kind to spark wars greater and uglier.
speaker: Outcast
content: And then there's you, 'The Elocutionist.' You're really into those five dollar words, trying your hardest to turn fancy talk into a political weapon, the kind to spark wars greater and uglier.

raw: [name="Outcast"]If I let any of you through, that girl will die, and all that evil I just talked about gets to carry on, free and clear.
speaker: Outcast
content: If I let any of you through, that girl will die, and all that evil I just talked about gets to carry on, free and clear.

speaker: Outcast
content: So—

content: She pops her last bullet into her revolver's cylinder.

raw: [name="Outcast"]It's about time for you to stand trial, for the last time.
speaker: Outcast
content: It's about time for you to stand trial, for the last time.

speaker: 'The Elocutionist'
content: This is your so-called faith?

raw: [name="Outcast"]You got the wrong idea. My faith ain't exactly the kind you're thinking of—
speaker: Outcast
content: You got the wrong idea. My faith ain't exactly the kind you're thinking of—

raw: [name="Outcast"]If I believe in anything, it's my gun.
speaker: Outcast
content: If I believe in anything, it's my gun.

raw: [name="'The Elocutionist'"]There is only one of you, and there are six of us.
speaker: 'The Elocutionist'
content: There is only one of you, and there are six of us.

raw: [name="Outcast"]I got enough ammo. Don't worry, nobody's missing out.
speaker: Outcast
content: I got enough ammo. Don't worry, nobody's missing out.

speaker: 'The Elocutionist'
content: You will die here.

speaker: Outcast
content: Lucky I won't do it alone.
'Outcast, I understand everything you said.'

raw: 'You've walked a great many roads. You've never looked back. You judge people with gunfire, but you know in your heart that the very last one awaiting judgment at the end of the road... is you.'
content: 'You've walked a great many roads. You've never looked back. You judge people with gunfire, but you know in your heart that the very last one awaiting judgment at the end of the road... is you.'

raw: 'I don't want you to get there—I don't want any one of you to get there.'
content: 'I don't want you to get there—I don't want any one of you to get there.'

raw: 'Fate is there to be shattered. You may be happy with this ending yourself, but I want to try to change it.'
content: 'Fate is there to be shattered. You may be happy with this ending yourself, but I want to try to change it.'

raw: 'Right. Even if the days gone by showed me my failure time and again, even if all of you left me one by one, I don't want to, and I can't accept this.'
content: 'Right. Even if the days gone by showed me my failure time and again, even if all of you left me one by one, I don't want to, and I can't accept this.'
'Outcast, give me this chance.'
'Come back alive.'

raw: [name="Outcast"]Aha, old friend... In the end, it looks like I'm not gonna be able to follow that order.
speaker: Outcast
content: Aha, old friend... In the end, it looks like I'm not gonna be able to follow that order.

raw: Six bullets shoot out of her revolver at once.
content: Six bullets shoot out of her revolver at once.

raw: At the same time, six enemies are charging toward her—
content: At the same time, six enemies are charging toward her—

raw: One of them is trying to hack away at her with his axe. Another is trying to spray a toxic gas at her. A third is trying to deflect her bullets with his Arts, while a fourth is trying to take the chance to dash past her, toward the other end of the alleyway.
content: One of them is trying to hack away at her with his axe. Another is trying to spray a toxic gas at her. A third is trying to deflect her bullets with his Arts, while a fourth is trying to take the chance to dash past her, toward the other end of the alleyway.

content: But their actions will forever be frozen at the very moment they began.

content: Before any of them can cry out in surprise or fall to the ground, they have turned to dust in a holy light.

content: The moment she fired her gun, their judgment was already complete.
